# ExplainableAutonomy

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property of an autonomous system to provide human-understandable justifications for its decisions and actions in real time. Mandates that iNEST architectures incorporate traceable decision pathways and interpretable representations, influencing how neuromorphic computations are structured and monitored.
